review_notes: I read the whole file. It adds only a Prop-valued structure bundling the finite claims, a theorem that repackages the earlier result, the combined proposition_3_1, and a derived limit. None of these defines a new concept that competes with Mathlib. The definitions the file relies on (qFactorial, PrimePowerIndex, proposition31DegreeCap, proposition31Amplitude) are defined in other files, not the target. PrimePowerIndex is an abbrev for the subtype {q // IsPrimePow q}, which is built from Mathlib's IsPrimePow. I did not check whether Mathlib has a q-factorial that qFactorial in FlagEnumeration.lean could be replaced by. Even if it did, that definition is outside this file's lines 1–139, so I did not report it.
